verdict.rationale: Airbyte's Connector Builder has a first-party AI Assistant. When you start a new connector, it automatically prefills and configures fields and sections. The Builder is a no-code UI on top of the low-code YAML format, where you review and refine the draft before using it in syncs. This matches the core of the story, but the evidence describes prefilling only 'a number of fields' and never confirms the specific elements the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the AI reads API documentation as input, that it generates auth, pagination and stream definitions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the drafted connectors actually work.
